title: Derived associated sheaf commutes naturally with cohomology
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and choose derived categories of A-modules and of sheaves on Spec A [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F : D(A) → D_QCoh(Spec A) have a natural isomorphism Q ⋙ F ⋙ inclusion ≅ termwise tilde ⋙ Q, for the associated-sheaf functor [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. For every integer n there is a natural isomorphism (F ⋙ inclusion) ⋙ H^n ≅ H^n ⋙ tilde.

proof.text: For a map f of modules, the kernel k of tilde(f) is quasi-coherent. Its ordinary counit tilde(Γ k) → k is invertible. Use full faithfulness of tilde to lift this kernel fork to modules; the image fork is isomorphic to the kernel fork, and full faithfulness reflects its limit property. Thus tilde preserves kernels.

The left adjoint tilde preserves colimits and is additive (preservation of biproducts). Together with kernel preservation, Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels supplies exactness. Apply Localization.liftNatIso to the given comparison and mapDerivedCategoryFactors to get F ⋙ inclusion ≅ tilde.mapDerivedCategory. Compose its whiskering with the inverse of the existing source-library Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso n; this is the required natural comparison.
